# Durga and Bhadrakali dance on Murugan's battlefield

`d-battlefield` | Ambal, Parvati, Durga and Kali | 5 songs

When Murugan fought the demons, the Goddess's attendants and Bhadrakali danced on the field, shouting the 'kulavai' cry, as the army of fiends feasted.
